scientific_integrity: Universal proof given; numerical finite-field checks independently corroborate but do not establish the universal theorem. Prime-characteristic divided-power obstruction acknowledged as known.
scientific_limitations: Complete attainable values and regular valuation-stratum sections; not a classification or count of all operators, not a scheme-theoretic image result; bounded literature search and residual risk of unlocated stronger sources.
title: Unit values of Rota–Baxter operators on modular truncated polynomial algebras
